title: Webinar and workshop refund policy
intro: How cancellations, transfers and refunds work for paid Bulletproof Automations webinars and standalone workshops, including the Get Paid for Automation series.

sections.heading: What this policy covers
paragraphs: This policy applies to paid webinars and standalone workshops booked on training.bulletproofautomations.com and paid through Paystack.
It does not apply to training cohorts or certification assessments. Those are covered by the cohort refund and cancellation policy at /refund-policy.

sections.heading: Cancelling for a full refund
paragraphs: You can cancel and receive a full refund of the amount you paid if you ask at least 48 hours before the workshop starts.
If you registered less than seven days before the workshop, you can also cancel for a full refund at any time before it starts, even inside the last 48 hours.

A full refund means the whole amount you paid, whether that was the standard fee or the Foundations certificate price. We do not deduct Paystack's processing fee, which Paystack does not return to us.

sections.heading: Cancelling later than that
paragraphs: Inside the last 48 hours, if the seven-day rule above does not apply, we do not give a cash refund. You can choose one of these instead, as long as you tell us before the workshop starts.
Send someone in your place. Email us their full name and email address, and the joining details go to them instead.

Move to a later session. Your payment moves once to a later paid Bulletproof Automations webinar or workshop that is open for registration within 12 months. If it costs more, you pay the difference. If it costs less, we refund the difference.

sections.heading: If you do not attend
paragraphs: If you do not attend and did not tell us before the workshop started, there is no refund and no transfer.
If you could not get in because of a problem on our side, such as a joining link that did not work, we treat it as our cancellation. Email us the same day.
If your own internet connection or device fails, contact us during the session and we will help you rejoin. A problem on your side is not grounds for a refund.

sections.heading: If we cancel, move or cut short a workshop
paragraphs: If we cancel a workshop, you receive a full refund. We start it within seven days of the cancellation. If you would rather move to another session, tell us and we will do that instead.
If we move a workshop to a new date, you can keep your place on the new date or have a full refund. The choice is yours.
If a problem on our side cuts a workshop short and we cannot finish it, you can choose a full refund or a place at a repeat session.

sections.heading: Duplicate payments and payments held for review
paragraphs: If you pay twice for the same registration, we refund the extra payment in full.

If the workshop fills while you are paying, or we cannot confirm your place automatically, your payment is held for review. We then either confirm your place or refund you in full. You do not need to pay again.
A complimentary Intermediate graduate place carries no payment, so there is nothing to refund. If you cannot attend, tell us before the workshop so the reserved place can go to another graduate.

sections.heading: How to ask
paragraphs: Email johnathan@bulletproofautomations.com from the address you registered with. Include the workshop name and your Paystack reference if you have it. It starts BPA-WEB- and is on your Paystack receipt.
We count the time of your request from when your email reaches us. We confirm in writing whether your request is approved.

sections.heading: How refunds are paid
paragraphs: Approved refunds are paid through Paystack, in cedis, to the payment method you used.
Paystack says customers should receive a refund within 3 to 10 working days of it being issued. The exact time depends on your mobile money provider or card issuer.
Paystack can only process a refund within one year of the payment. Requests under this policy are made well within that time.
A refund is not complete until Paystack confirms it has been processed. We tell you when that happens, and we will not tell you a refund has been sent before then.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: This policy does not limit any rights you have under the consumer protection law that applies to you.
The version of this policy in force when you registered is the one that applies to your registration.
